title: What is your spirit animal? Free personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free spirit animal quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're a wolf, owl, fox, bear, eagle, dolphin, deer or otter, and what that says about you. No sign-up.
lede: Loyal wolf, wise owl or playful otter? Answer 12 questions about your friends, your free time and your weak spots to find the animal that matches your personality.
about: People have long used animals as a shorthand for character: sly as a fox, wise as an owl, loyal as a wolf. This quiz uses those familiar images to match you with one of eight animals based on how you act with others, handle trouble and recharge.

It is just for fun, written for cv.cm. Spirit animals and animal guides have real meaning in a number of Indigenous and other spiritual traditions; this quiz doesn't draw on them or claim to reveal anything spiritual. Think of it as a playful personality quiz.

faq.a: Wolf, owl, fox, bear, eagle, dolphin, deer and otter. Your result names your main animal and shows your score for all eight.

faq.q: Is one animal rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every animal appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Is this a real spiritual reading?
faq.a: No. It is a fun personality quiz with no spiritual basis, and it doesn't represent any tradition's beliefs.

faq.q: Why did I get a different animal this time?
faq.a: A few changed answers can shift close scores. If two animals tie, the result names both, and you may well have something of each.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.body: You are loyal and protective, and at your best with your pack around you. You stand by your people and make sure nobody gets left behind. Remember that you can also have needs of your own.

owl.name: Owl
owl.body: You are thoughtful and observant. You notice what others miss and give advice worth hearing. You may stay in your head too long, so share your ideas before they're perfect.

fox.name: Fox
fox.body: You are quick-witted and adaptable, and you can find a way around almost anything. People enjoy your cleverness. Let them see the real you once in a while, too.

bear.name: Bear
bear.body: You are strong, calm and protective, with a need for your own quiet den. People feel safe around you. Don't wait too long before coming out of hibernation to say what you need.

eagle.name: Eagle
eagle.body: You are independent and far-sighted. You like the big picture, and you'd rather set your own course than follow the crowd. Don't forget to come down to earth and bring people with you.

dolphin.name: Dolphin
dolphin.body: You are friendly, bright and at your happiest with others. You make people feel welcome and bring groups together. Make time for yourself too, away from everyone's needs.

deer.name: Deer
deer.body: You are gentle and perceptive, and you sense moods before anyone speaks. Your kindness calms people. You can get hurt easily, so choose those who treat your softness with care.

otter.name: Otter
otter.body: You are playful and curious, and you find the fun in nearly everything. You lift the mood wherever you go. When something serious comes up, you are stronger than you think, so don't swim away from it.
